def can_make_interesting_problemset(n, k, knowledge):
    # Check all possible subsets of problems
    for mask in range(1, 1 << n):
        valid = True
        for team in range(k):
            known_problems = 0
            for problem in range(n):
                if mask & (1 << problem) and knowledge[problem][team] == 1:
                    known_problems += 1
            if known_problems > (mask.bit_count() // 2):
                valid = False
                break
        if valid:
            return "YES"
    return "NO"

# Read input
n, k = map(int, input().split())
knowledge = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]

# Determine if an interesting problemset can be made
result = can_make_interesting_problemset(n, k, knowledge)

# Print the result
print(result)
